name: Rev. Sarah Mitchell
title: Chair
bio: Rev. Mitchell has served Ojai's faith community for over 15 years and has been a founding voice of the Interfaith Council.

name: Rabbi David Cohen
title: Vice Chair
bio: Rabbi Cohen brings a deep commitment to dialogue and understanding, leading Ojai's Jewish community for a decade.

name: Imam Yusuf Al-Amin
title: Secretary
bio: Imam Al-Amin is a passionate advocate for bridge-building and has led numerous interfaith education programs in Ventura County.

name: Sister Maria Luz
title: Treasurer
bio: Sister Maria Luz has served communities across California and brings decades of compassionate service to the Council.

name: Swami Anandaji
title: Member at Large
bio: Swami Anandaji leads meditation and wisdom teachings at the Ojai Foundation and has been part of the Council since its inception.

name: Dr. Lena Park
title: Member at Large
bio: Dr. Park is a teacher and practitioner in the Zen tradition, and coordinates the Council's community outreach programs.
